f822af.title: Vulnerability Testing: SQL Injection - Login & Search
f822af.description: Test login endpoint (/api/auth/login) and product search for SQL injection vulnerabilities. Challenge #26 (Ephemeral Accountant) indicates this vector exists.

395abf.title: Vulnerability Testing: XSS - Feedback Form & Reviews
395abf.description: Test feedback form (/api/complain) and review endpoints for stored and reflected XSS. Multiple DOM XSS challenges indicate weak input sanitization.

a16a85.title: Vulnerability Testing: IDOR - Product & User Data
a16a85.description: Test for insecure direct object reference in product IDs, order IDs, user profiles, and basket items. Challenge #1 indicates password hash exposure via API.

5566d8.title: Vulnerability Testing: Admin Access Control Bypass
5566d8.description: Attempt to access /#/admin panel without proper authentication. Challenge #5 (Admin Section) is difficulty 2, indicating a moderate bypass technique.

c0e95e.title: Vulnerability Testing: Authentication Bypass
c0e95e.description: Test login form for SQL injection with 'acc0unt4nt@juice-sh.op' account. Test weak password policies, account enumeration, and forgotten account creation.

93ba8f.title: Vulnerability Testing: Business Logic - Price Manipulation
93ba8f.description: Test shopping cart for price manipulation and free deluxe membership bypass (Challenge #99). Test concurrent purchase race conditions.

c6ccbf.title: Vulnerability Testing: CSRF - State Changing Operations
c6ccbf.description: Test CSRF protection on profile updates, order placement, and password changes. Challenge #100 indicates CSRF is exploitable.

8ed5ae.title: Vulnerability Testing: File Upload & Path Traversal
8ed5ae.description: Test photo upload for file type bypass, path traversal, and null byte injection (Challenge #105). Test file download for LFI (Challenge #106).

f292b2.title: Vulnerability Testing: Password Reset Weakness
f292b2.description: Test password reset with weak security questions (Challenges #7, #102, #104). Test for token reuse and timing attacks.

3d668e.title: Vulnerability Testing: XXE - File Upload/API
3d668e.description: Test XML parsing endpoints for XXE vulnerabilities (Challenges #91, #92). Test file upload for XXE injection and external entity processing.

ee6643.title: Vulnerability Testing: Information Disclosure
ee6643.description: Verify exposure of password hashes via API, debug endpoints, error pages. Test for exposed credentials (Challenge #109) and leaked API keys (Challenge #110).

463183.title: Vulnerability Testing: Rate Limiting & CAPTCHA
463183.description: Test CAPTCHA bypass on feedback form (Challenge #14). Test rate limiting on login attempts and API endpoints.

7e44e8.title: API Endpoint Enumeration - Protected Endpoints
7e44e8.description: Attempt to access all 500-returning endpoints with proper authentication. Test /api/user, /api/orders, /api/basket with valid session tokens.

c126c7.title: Authentication Testing - JWT Manipulation
c126c7.description: Extract JWT tokens from login response. Test algorithm confusion (alg:none), signature bypass, and claim manipulation (Challenges #41-42).

a292dc.title: LLM Chatbot Testing - Prompt Injection
a292dc.description: Test AI chatbot at /#/ai-chat for prompt injection attacks (Challenges #111-114). Extract system prompt and bypass coupon policies.

c3850d.title: Infrastructure Scanning - IaC & Docker
c3850d.description: Look for Infrastructure-as-Code files (Challenge #98). Identify vulnerable Docker image in use (Challenge #116).

5e4ca5.title: Data Leakage - Photo Wall Metadata
5e4ca5.description: Check photo wall uploads for geo-location metadata (Challenges #103-104). Test for EXIF data exposure.

588782.title: Deserialization & RCE Testing
588782.description: Test for unsafe deserialization on file upload and API endpoints (Challenges #13, #93). Test YAML bomb and gadget chains.

f52b29.title: Email/Cross-Domain Data Leakage
f52b29.description: Test for XS-Leaks to extract email addresses (Challenge #24). Test for cross-domain data access vulnerabilities.

3ca86f.title: Comprehensive Report Generation
3ca86f.description: After all testing, compile findings into vulnerability reports with PoC, remediation, and CVSS scoring.

2a2ebb.description: Analyze the JWT token for algorithm confusion or weak signatures

747b18.title: Document and file vulnerability reports
747b18.description: Create detailed PoC and file reports for each confirmed vulnerability

befa7a.title: Price Manipulation Testing
befa7a.description: Test cart add/modify requests and price parameter manipulation

6f7331.title: Coupon/Promotion Code Testing
6f7331.description: Test invalid codes, reuse, race conditions, brute force, SQL injection

4999af.title: File Upload & Path Traversal
4999af.description: Test extension bypass, content-type manipulation, path traversal

462523.title: Password Reset & Security Questions
462523.description: Test password reset, security question enumeration, token reuse

e14fca.title: Rate Limiting & CAPTCHA Bypass
e14fca.description: Test rate limiting, CAPTCHA bypass, concurrent requests

26dacb.title: IDOR: User data access via /api/Users/{id}
26dacb.description: Can access any user's email, role, and deluxe tokens
